The '''Lantern Guild''' is a craft guild of lamplighters founded in the year 312 of the Commonwealth on [[Calador Prime]].<ref name="annals">{{Cite book |title=Annals of the Commonwealth |author=Unknown scribe |year=2026 |page=12}}</ref> It keeps the public lamps of the capital burning and trains apprentices in the old oil-lamp craft.

== History ==
{{Main|History of the Lantern Guild}}
The guild began as an informal company of night workers and received its charter after the long blackout of 311.<ref name="annals" /> By the mid-fourth century it had chapters in every district of the capital.<ref>{{Cite book |title=Guild rolls, district chapters |publisher=Lantern Guild archive |year=2026}}</ref>

== Organization ==
Members advance from '''apprentice''' to '''journeyman''' to '''lamplighter'''. A Master of Lamps is chosen every ten years.

{{Quote|text=No street left dark.|author=Guild motto}}
